Tweedie random draws (compound Poisson-Gamma)

Source: R/fishery_catch.R
rtweedie_cpg.Rd

Draws from a Tweedie distribution with mean mu, power p (1 < p < 2) and dispersion phi (Var = phi mu^p) through its compound Poisson-Gamma representation, without external dependencies.

Usage

rtweedie_cpg(mu, p, phi)

Arguments

mu

Vector of means.

p

Power parameter.

phi

Dispersion.

Value

Numeric vector (with exact zeros).

Examples

set.seed(1)
x <- rtweedie_cpg(rep(0.5, 1e4), 1.4, 1)
c(mean = mean(x), prop_zero = mean(x == 0))
#>      mean prop_zero 
#> 0.5067768 0.3319000
